decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent formwork system that survived the initial launch years while the firm and industry were growing, it still looks like a low-cost option worth keeping unless demand clearly weakens.

This magnet block fits the firm's modular formwork offering and, having remained after early pruning of other launches, is likely cheap to carry and still valuable to retain despite some uncertainty about scale.

Because this magnetic formwork component is close to the established business and was given dedicated presentation, management would likely view it as a proven extension with limited reason to withdraw soon.

Although this product seems somewhat less prominent than the stronger launches, it is still closely related to the firm's existing technology base, so the option value of keeping it likely exceeds its carrying cost for now.
